dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors, hunters, researchers, and local residents using or living near the Shawnee National Forest in Illinois.
dimensions.evidence: certain land in the Shawnee National Forest in the State of Illinois

dimensions.assessment: Alters management rules, restricts vehicular and commercial timber access, and establishes permanent wilderness and special management protections on specific federal acreage.
dimensions.evidence: designated as wilderness and as a component of the National Wilderness Preservation System

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for management plans, trail maintenance, and potential private inholding acquisitions from willing sellers.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall acquire any private inholdings in the Special Management Areas by purchase or exchange from willing sellers

dimensions.assessment: Modifies public land designations, restricts commercial timber and motor vehicle use, and sets specific management requirements for designated areas.
dimensions.evidence: Commercial timber harvesting in the Special Management Areas... shall be prohibited.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent wilderness and special management area designations and land withdrawals.
dimensions.evidence: all Federal land within the Special Management Areas... is withdrawn from entry

missing_information: Total projected federal cost for acquiring private inholdings and implementing management plans.
importance_detail.rationale: Designates approximately 750 acres as wilderness and establishes three Special Management Areas totaling thousands of acres within the Shawnee National Forest in Illinois.
